# libaes67 and libmdns (vendored)

Copied unmodified from Manifold (`libs/aes67`, `libs/mdns`) at commit
`43af174a87072209bf1a9f513f8c1437df4d5c19`. AGPL-3.0-only, copyright Meros Inc.

These libraries are moving to their own repository, `meros-co/aes67`. When it is published,

go to the shared repository.
